messages.subject: regions.xls file - confirming the build.
parts:
Hello

I have a regions.xls file after analysing 10K snp chip files and just
wanted to confirm that I am looking at the correct genome build.

In this file are columns headed 'Chromosome' 'start' 'stop' and 'url'

'url' references hg17, e.g.
http://genome.ucsc.edu/cgi-bin/hgTracks?clade=vertebrate&org=Human&db=hg17&position=chr5%:38217727-42101341
so I would assume that the Chromosome, start and stop columns, which
differ from the coordinates in the url entry, refer to hg18, e.g.
the url mentioned above is on the same line as:
Chromosome start stop
5 40,067,067 40,252,001

I am just checking as I did a liftOver on the coordinates in the url
(from hg17 to hg18) and that didn't give me the region under the
'Chromosome, start, stop' entry.

cheers

Lavinia.

On 7/1/07, Lavinia Gordon <lavinia...@mcri.edu.au> wrote:
>
> Hello
>
> I have a regions.xls file after analysing 10K snp chip files and just
> wanted to confirm that I am looking at the correct genome build.
>
> In this file are columns headed 'Chromosome' 'start' 'stop' and 'url'
>
> 'url' references hg17, e.g.
> http://genome.ucsc.edu/cgi-bin/hgTracks?clade=vertebrate&org=Human&db=hg17&position=chr5%:38217727-42101341
> so I would assume that the Chromosome, start and stop columns, which
> differ from the coordinates in the url entry, refer to hg18, e.g.
> the url mentioned above is on the same line as:
> Chromosome start stop
> 5 40,067,067 40,252,001

The '<xlim[1]>-<xlim[2]>' in the URL string, e.g. '38217727-42101341',
specifies *the region to be displayed* and is calculated as:

start <- 40067067
stop <- 40252001
width <- abs(stop-start)
margin <- 10
xlim <- c(max(start - margin*width, 0), stop + margin*width);

which explains why 'xlim' is different from 'c(start, stop)'.

>
> I am just checking as I did a liftOver on the coordinates in the url
> (from hg17 to hg18) and that didn't give me the region under the
> 'Chromosome, start, stop' entry.

I have hardwired 'hg17' in the URL, that is, the genome version is
currently not inferred from anywhere. The genome version used is the
one used to create the dChip genome information file, e.g.
10K_Xba142_genome_info_hg17.xls. This far I don't think dChip provide
genome information files for other genome versions than 'hg17'. If
that happens, the URL will still say 'hg17' (until I come up with
clever and safe way to infer the version number).

Cheers

Henrik
